description.value: Banana Leaf is Vancouver's original Malaysian restaurant, established in 1995 and now operating five Metro Vancouver locations. The Broadway flagship on the corner of West Broadway and Oak offers over 40 dishes drawing from Malaysian, Indonesian, Singaporean, Thai, Chinese, and Indian influences. A touring cyclist seeking a substantial sit-down meal on the Broadway corridor will find a full-service restaurant with dine-in and takeout options.

bike_parking_detail: 4 racks within 100m: stands (20 spaces, covered) at 55m; rack at 91m; stands (6 spaces) at 92m; rack at 96m. Total: 26 spaces.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website is live and corroborates the OSM address (820 W. Broadway) and provides a phone number (604-731-6333) not present in OSM. The site confirms takeout/pickup and delivery options via prominent nav links. No mention of bike parking, bike racks, water refill, Wi-Fi, or device charging anywhere on the site or in OSM tags; OSM confirms indoor seating only (outdoor_seating=no), ruling out patio bike visibility.
concerns: Phone number 604-731-6333 is present on the website but absent from OSM — OSM record should be updated.
OSM outdoor_seating=no eliminates patio bike visibility; no other bike parking or visibility evidence found anywhere.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Business is clearly active and a viable food stop on a major cycling corridor, but none of the three WWC required criteria (bike parking/visibility, water bottle refill, washrooms) could be confirmed from the website or OSM tags. On-site verification is needed before accreditation.
enrichment_extras.notes: The website URL (bananaleaf-vancouver.com) serves all five locations; the Broadway-specific page is not separately hosted. All location-level contact details are listed in the site footer.

wow_evidence: Vancouver's original Malaysian restaurant, established in 1995 and now operating five Metro Vancouver locations
